$description: The light theme of the Spree 6.0.3 admin dashboard, written from the custom properties its stylesheet declares on :root and the Tailwind utilities its components use (read 2026-11-25). Each token's $description names the variable or utility it comes from. Read by helpers/design-tokens.ts (ADR 0015); the contract is docs/features/design.md.

card.$description: --card: cards and the inside of form controls.

primary.$description: --primary, which the stylesheet sets to var(--foreground): the primary button.

primary-foreground.$description: --primary-foreground, which the stylesheet sets to var(--card): text on the primary button.

border.$description: --border-base, through --border: the border of a form control at rest.

ring.$description: --brand-blue, through --ring: the border of a focused form control and the outline of a focused link.

link-hover.$description: --link-hover: a text link under the pointer.

base.$description: --text-base, and the font size of body: body text and form controls.

touch-control.$description: max(1rem, var(--text-base)) on a coarse pointer: the smallest size of a form control on a touch screen.

xl.$description: .text-xl: the heading of a section below 640 px.

2xl.$description: .text-2xl: the heading of a page, and of a section from 640 px.
